raw_text: AltNews verification: The viral video purportedly showing fresh shelling along the India-Pakistan Line of Control is old footage from 2019. We traced the video to a February 27, 2019 upload following the Balakot airstrikes. Key identifiers include the time-stamp overlay visible in the original broadcast, terrain features matching known 2019 positions, and the identical audio track. No Indian or Pakistani military authority has confirmed any new exchange of fire.
clean_text: AltNews verifies viral LoC shelling video as 2019 footage from Balakot era. Time-stamp overlay, terrain features, and audio track match original. No military authority confirms new exchange.
